name: s69-stop-gate-worktree-cwd-keeps-main-failure
setup_commands: git init -q . && git -c user.name=kitbench -c user.email=kitbench@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git worktree add -q -b kitbench-wt .claude/worktrees/x
notes: A broken edit in the main checkout, then the session moves into a git worktree. stop-gate used to read only the cwd's worktree state, so a stop from inside the worktree was allowed while the main checkout still failed. It now checks CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR's state too and blocks if either does.
